parameters.content:
## Error → shared redaction → private execution ownership → owned activity
Unattributed system errors stay inaccessible to users. Matching/action errors are mapped to their owner, logged and queued for notification through the Act worker. No raw credentials or execution inputs are copied. This workflow never recursively invokes itself.
